task.description: Diagnose ISS-0619 (GH-568): three integration tests fail — TC-IDN-02-06 and TC-IDN-02-07 expected 200 but got 403, TC-IDN-03-03b expected 200 but got 500. Confirmed by direct test run against `postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test`.
acceptance_criteria: Determine whether idn02 and idn03 share a root cause

result.summary: Root cause pinned. TC-IDN-02-06/07: `handleComplete` in src/api/routes/tasks.zig (Branch 3) denies TASK_WORKER completion of GROUP-assigned tasks that are not yet claimed, but the test expects any active group member to be able to complete directly. TC-IDN-03-03b: the GROUP clause in `listCursor` (src/tasks/store.zig around line 615) references `tasks.assignee_ref` in `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members ...)` but the outer column is a uuid string with implicit cast — the SQL likely fails on serialization. Need to dig deeper: idn02 and idn03 share a GROUP membership resolution path; the test expectations confirm the design intent: active group members DO complete GROUP tasks and ARE listed by /tasks.

issues.description: handleComplete Branch 3 unconditionally denies TASK_WORKER on GROUP-assigned unclaimed tasks. Fix: allow when actor is an active member of the assignee group (via canClaimGroupTask / isActiveGroupMember).

listCursor GROUP clause uses `--assignee_ref ::uuid` cast in the lhs EXISTS but the OR shortcircuit may be evaluating the GROUP branch in a way that breaks when no GM row exists; or the assignee_ref cast is missing. Need to verify the SQL against the actual Postgres plan.
